note: BH-7215. How long a new pool machine waits for the hub to push its env and job.json before it exits 0 and autostops. spawn_one passes it as `-e WARMUP_WAIT_S=<n>` on `fly machine run`, and fly/builder-runner.sh reads it. Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.warmup_wait_s`. The old fixed 600 s lost project-6-os spawns whose hub setup took about 12 minutes (#7174). An idle performance-8x for 20 more minutes costs about $0.15; a lost spawn costs a full tick, about 30 minutes.
